review_evidence: README ties the repository to the paper “We Cannot Agree to Disagree, Formally” and states the proofs were developed and verified in Lean.
Primary source includes project, input, and output variants for AgreeToDisagree and belief formalizations; rough declaration scan found 145 definitions/theorems/related declarations.
Generated or duplicated provenance was not treated as irrelevance; exact-content aliases remain governed separately by FD-006 where applicable.
summary: Reviewed AgreeToDisagree; all seven primary Lean files are retained because both generated/input/output copies contain formal statements and proofs relevant to the Aumann formalization.
